high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post. The top portion of the image features a black-and-white portrait of Fyodor Dostoevsky, a famous Russian author. The text overlay on the image is a quote attributed to him, which reads: "You sensed that you should be following a different path, a more ambitious one. You felt that you were destined for other things but you had no idea how to achieve them and in your misery you began to hate everything around you.
